'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Sherrington DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sherrington]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Charles Barkley Statue
* '''Username:''' malix solosar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
